description: On-site mobile audio guide apps: simple flow, QR navigation, and reliable audio playback.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
A series of mobile apps designed for visitors, on smartphones, in real conditions (mixed devices, sometimes weak network, non-technical users).

  • Clear flow: choose → open a point → listen.
  • QR to reach the right content fast, without friction.
  • Content easy to update without rebuilding the app.

sections.title: What I owned
sections.content:
• Hybrid architecture .NET MAUI + Blazor: fast UI iteration with a native mobile base.
  • Stabilised sensitive parts: audio (interruptions/resume) + camera/QR (permissions, clear error states).
  • Android/iOS delivery: production builds, packaging, and platform constraints.
